title: German-Style Pan-Fried Pork Dumplings
description: A twist on traditional German cuisine, these pan-fried pork dumplings are filled with a spiced pork mixture and served with a side of sweet chili sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the yellow onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
4. Add the spicy Chinese sauce and stir to combine.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
6. Meanwhile, cook the dumplings according to package instructions.
7. Add the cooked dumplings to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until crispy on the bottom.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onion if desired.
9. Serve with a side of sweet chili sauce for dipping.
